archetypes.name: dyn-oos-counter-parity
archetypes.rationale: The design prepare path now depends on shared file_oos counter semantics instead of the deleted awk helper.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare design_oos._count_non_security_blocks and file_oos._count_non_security_markdown against the retired awk behavior described in the diff. Focus on empty input, canonical OOS headers, legacy tagged FINDING headers, security headers, and focus-area field handling. Verify that the prepare flow still writes order and combined files only for non-security unfiled design OOS blocks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-retired-oos-surface
archetypes.rationale: Deleting retired awk files can leave stale runtime or prose references that lint may not cover in every surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the diff for references to the three deleted awk helpers outside the migration manifest and excluded run logs. Check shell harnesses, skill prose, and OOS pipeline references for stale names or mismatched authority claims. Verify the migration manifest rows use the expected retired_by identifier and that no deleted helper remains on disk. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
